svg.title: One episode loop, two timings
svg.desc: core.kernel.EpisodeRunner in sync mode (the world waits for each policy call) and realtime mode (policy calls overlap execution, stale actions are dropped, a hold action fills an empty queue).
svg.text: (default): the world waits for every policy call; a chunk runs execution_steps actions
Benchmarks score the policy alone: latency never changes an outcome.
the robot keeps its control rate; the next chunk is computed while the current one runs
chunk 2 is computed from o5 and arrives at step 8: its actions 0–2 went stale while it was computed and are dropped
the next chunk is requested when ≤ refill_steps actions remain, earlier if recent latency says so
an empty queue executes the hold action; more than max_hold_steps holds in a row abort
virtual: latency measured or fixed (latency_s), deterministic, for benchmarks; wall: a worker thread, on robots
k·j = action j of chunk k. Every executed action passes the SafetyShield; every step is traced (both modes).
